correctness.rationale: Exact paired recursion gives scalar contraction \(1-r^2\) and additive innovation \(h(\xi_1-(I+rS)\xi_0)\). Independent pairs yield a scalar geometric sum at every finite horizon. In the two eigendirections of the symmetric update, marginal-variance Cauchy–Schwarz bounds are attained by a feasible orthogonal Gaussian coupling; strict equality identifies the unique minimizer except at \(r=1\). Algebra establishes both stationary risk curves and limits for every \(0<r<\sqrt2\). Standard-library exact-rational verification checks 5,676 comparisons; these are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The primary signed-GDA paper poses robustness to noisy gradients as a motivated next problem. This result exactly quantifies an unexpected fixed positive steady-state error floor for independent zero-stepsize observations and a nontrivial sharp swap of two coordinate noises for higher stable steps. These are actionable stochastic-oracle benchmark boundaries with explicitly restricted scope, beyond a rename of the deterministic theorem.
